title: Herbstferien Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Herbstferien Berlin 2026 run from Monday 19 to Saturday 31 October;** the last school day is Friday 16 October and school starts again on Monday 2 November.
**That is ten working days to cover:** 19 to 23 and 26 to 30 October.
**The Hort covers the holidays too.** Grades 1 to 3 pay nothing and need no needs check for 7:30 to 16:00; early care from 6:00 and late care to 18:00 are booked modules.
**The gap is usually the late afternoon:** with a 16:00 Hort, an 8:30 to 17:00 job and 30 minutes each way, an hour and a half a day stays open.
**A new Hort application needs at least three months,** so for these holidays only an existing place helps. Send back your Hort's holiday list now.
**The Super-Ferien-Pass costs €9:** one free indoor swim every holiday day (entry by 12:00, out by 14:00) and free Zoo and Tierpark entry for children up to 15.
**Two dates to plan around:** the clocks go back on Sunday 25 October, and Saturday 31 October is Reformationstag, a public holiday in Brandenburg but not in Berlin.
